summary.en-GB: Customise your YouTube grid, hide Shorts and Playables, and enjoy a cleaner feed with your own layout.

version.approval_notes: Build with Node.js 24: npm ci, npm run build, npm run zip, npm run lint:firefox. See docs/FIREFOX_STORE.md in the attached matching source archive. Two innerHTML warnings originate in the unmodified React DOM 18.3.1 renderer. The extension does not use innerHTML or dangerouslySetInnerHTML. All code is bundled; no remote code or analytics. No extension account is needed. Test popup layout and hide controls on YouTube, separate channel settings, and saved preferences after reopening the popup.
